metas.name: Buddy's Day Out
metas.description: This cartoon has some amusing sight gags like a car going back through a fence and crashing into various animals before landing in Cookie's yard or a train that seems on its way into crashing into a car with Elmer and Happy inside when Buddy and Cookie use a ladder to derail the locomotive in anothe

metas.name: I've Got to Sing a Torch Song
metas.description: Blackout gags and music, including the title song originated in the movie musical Gold Diggers of 1933. Hollywood figures caricatured include Tallulah Bankhead, Joan Blondell, James Cagney, Bing Crosby, Guy Kibbee, Zasu Pitts, Mae West, Bert Wheeler and Bob Woolsey, Ed Wynn, George Bernard Shaw, Mus

metas.name: Buddy's Show Boat
metas.description: Buddy's boat floats merrily down the river as there are various musical and dance shows performed.

metas.name: Sittin' on a Backyard Fence
metas.description: Male cats fight each other over a female cat around the backyard fence.

metas.name: Pettin' in the Park
metas.description: While at the park, a group of birds engage in a swimming contest. Another cartoon by Warner Brothers promoting a song from its movie "Gold Diggers of 1933".

metas.name: Honeymoon Hotel
metas.description: After introducing the small town of Bugtown, inhabitated by bugs, this short shows what happens to two honeymooning lovebugs at the Honeymoon Hotel, due to the fact that their love is a little bit too hot.

metas.name: Buddy's Garage
metas.description: While having lunch at the garage, Cookie is kidnapped by a man and Buddy gets in a car chase to rescue her.

metas.name: Those Were Wonderful Days
metas.description: Animated musical short. Songs including Oh You Beautiful Doll, Put on Your Old Grey Bonnet, In the Shade of the Old Apple Tree.

metas.name: Buddy's Bearcats
metas.description: Buddy's baseball team, the Bearcats, takes on the Battling Bruisers in the big stadium. The crowd buys tickets and hot dogs before settling down to watch the game....

metas.name: Buddy the Detective
metas.description: We're introduced to a Mad Doctor-type who's bored with just playing the piano by himself on the same dirge. So he kidnaps Buddy's girlfriend, Cookie, by hypnotizing her over the phone before making her play the same thing!

metas.name: Buddy's Circus
metas.description: Buddy runs a circus with a variety of zany acts, and ends up having to rescue a baby who gets lost during the performance.

metas.name: Viva Buddy
metas.description: Buddy goes to Mexico.

metas.name: Buddy's Lost World
metas.description: In this Leon Schlesinger/Looney Tunes cartoon short, Buddy and his dog Bozo are sailing to the Lost World, you know, that world inhabited by cavemen and dinosaurs as first depicted by Sir Arthur Conan Doyle in his novel of the same name.

metas.name: Buddy's Bug Hunt
metas.description: An early reference to an 'Acme' product occurs here as in the dream sequence is printed on 'Acme Fly Paper'.

metas.name: Buddy Steps Out
metas.description: When Cookie heads out with the real Buddy, the photo of Buddy comes to life as the figure steps out. Various other objects in the house begin to come to life when she is away, including women on soup cans and a man with a globe. This cartoon is basically a musical number.

metas.name: Buddy the Gee Man
metas.description: "Federal Agent Buddy" receives a telegram stating, "Conduct secret investigation as to the treatment accorded prisoners by ward at Sing Song Prison. signed, Fuller Pepp, chief."

metas.name: A Cartoonist's Nightmare
metas.description: A cartoonist falls asleep at the drawing board and into the clutches of his own villains, until Beans the Cat comes to the rescue.

metas.name: Hollywood Capers
metas.description: W.C.Fields enters the Warmer Bros. Studio. Beans tries to drive in, but the guard throws him and his car against a tree. metas.name: Alpine Antics
metas.description: Prologue: various animals enjoy winter sports. Beans sees a notice of a ski race, and decides to enter. But so does a bad guy (who looks more than a little like Disney's Pete). The bad guy sabotages the other contestants in various ways, takes short cuts, etc. But Beans manages to tie up the bad guy

metas.name: The Phantom Ship
metas.description: Uncle Beans and the kids are off to visit haunted ship 'The Phantom' trapped in the ice, hoping to find pirate treasure. metas.name: Boom Boom
metas.description: World War I, apparently. There is a series of quick blackout gags, including a soldier that throws the pin...

metas.name: The Fire Alarm
metas.description: 2 puppets are left to their uncle's attention who works at the Fire house.

metas.name: Westward Whoa
metas.description: Porky Pig and his friends Beans, Little Kitty and Ham and Ex, travel as pioneers toward the western frontier. As their wagon travels across the prairie, Ham and Ex cause trouble by pretending to be Indians. Then the real Indians show up!

metas.name: Fish Tales
metas.description: Porky Pig goes fishing. It's not quite the outing he anticipated.

metas.name: Shanghaied Shipmates
metas.description: Porky and some of his fellow sailors are on shore leave in a bar. A pirate captain discovers that his own crew has jumped ship and forces everyone in the bar to become his crew. The captain treats the crew badly, particularly denying them food (eating the meat off bones, then passing them only the b

metas.name: Porky's Pet
metas.description: Porky and his pet ostrich, Lulu, get invited to perform on Broadway for $75/week. But first they have to get there, and the train conductor won't let the ostrich board. metas.name: Porky's Moving Day
metas.description: A woman's house, on the side of the cliff, is about to fall into the sea, due to waves washing away the cliff. In a panic, she call's Porky's moving company. metas.name: Porky and Gabby
metas.description: Porky Pig and ill-tempered Gabby Goat go on a camping outing. Chaos ensues.

metas.name: Porky's Super Service
metas.description: Porky owns a full-service gas station; he deals with a wide variety of problems, like a bump that migrates to different parts of the car.
